builds.name: Leveling — Enhancement (Stormstrike at 25, Rage of the Farseer at 40)
builds.summary: Classic Enhancement leveling reached Stormstrike at 40; in Forever it is the 16-point talent, so it lands at 25. Thundering Strikes (now crit with everything) first, Mental Dexterity (AP from Intellect, and the Flurry prerequisite), Shamanistic Focus at 20 for cheap shocks, Elemental Weapons, Stormstrike, Flurry, Improved Stormstrike (mana regen), Mental Quickness, Maelstrom Weapon (instant Lightning Bolts) and Rage of the Farseer at 40. Then Concussion/Reverberation for shocks and Tidal Mastery/Tidal Focus for hit. Ends in the Forever Enhancement raid build.

core.why: +5% crit with all spells and attacks — better than Classic's melee-only version, so it stays first.
New: AP from Intellect (33%/rank read — scaling unclear) and the Flurry prerequisite.
New 1-pointer at 20: shocks and Lightning Shield cost 45% less — mana was the Classic Enhancement leveling problem.
Windfury Weapon +13%/rank (est. 40%) from 30 when Windfury is learned; Rockbiter before.
16-pt at 25 (Classic: 40): weapon strike + 20% Nature damage taken for shocks.
Haste after crits (demo rank 1 = 5%; est. 25%).
New: 50% chance for 50% mana regen while casting after Stormstrike — the sustain talent.
New: melee hits stack a cheaper/faster Lightning Bolt (5 stacks) — instant bolts to open or finish.
Capstone at 40: +30% attack and cast speed for 25s every 3 minutes.
+5% hit with everything (est.) — last because it needs 5 Restoration filler points first.

alternatives: Improved Ghost Wolf 2 (indoors Ghost Wolf, 1.0s faster) and respec at 60
flex.why: Improved Ghost Wolf is the best quality-of-life pick while leveling; it is not in the 60 build.

alternatives: Convection

core.why: New: 17%/rank regen while casting (est. 51%). Healer lab (2026-09-26): removing it costs +16% healing capacity.
+24% Healing Wave (est.); Riptide prerequisite. Healer lab (2026-09-26): removing it costs +8% healing capacity.
+10% healing. Healer lab (2026-09-26): removing it costs +5% healing capacity.
Cheaper heals plus 5% spell hit (est.). Healer lab (2026-09-26): removing it costs +5% healing capacity.
New: mana on being hit or on crit heals. Healer lab (2026-09-26): removing it costs +4% healing capacity.
Now a 16-point talent. Healer lab (2026-09-26): removing it costs +3% healing capacity.
+10% Intellect (est.). Healer lab (2026-09-26): removing it costs +2% healing capacity.
Armor on crit heals (8%/rank est. 24%). Healer lab (2026-09-26): removing it costs +2% healing capacity.

notes: 2026-09-30 (raid_path_leveling.py, user decision): healer and tank specs level into their raid build. Orders raced (fight lab, seed 3, 3000 fights per level, level-weighted): stats model's order 43 s; own tree first 44 s; own tree last 44 s. First Restoration point at level 10.
Fight-lab numbers are a model of the beta, not in-game measurements.

builds.name: Enhancement — Raid (machine-learning search)
builds.summary: The Enhancement build the machine-learning talent search found in a full raid (every raid buff and debuff: the group setting) on 2026-10-03 in the community simulator, in the spec's phase-1 BiS gear and the raid rotation of the entry enhancement-dps (raidsim/ml_talents.py: a random forest trained on simulated builds guides a genetic search over every legal build of the spec; the finalists are raced on fresh seeds and the winner is checked against all its one-move and prerequisite-chain neighbours).
notes: Against the best hand draft enhancement-raid-dps in a full raid, same gear and fights (100,000, one seed): +7.9% (over the 2% bar: this build is the spec's raid pick, the hand draft stays as the alternative).

Search result (full raid): 19/32/0 at 801.3 ± 0.12 DPS over 200,000 fights; runner-up 19/32/0 (+0.05%; the winner takes Ancestral Knowledge 5, Elemental Weapons 2; the runner-up Ancestral Knowledge 4, Elemental Weapons 3); 7,070 builds simulated; certificate: none of its 322 one-move and chain-move neighbours was 0.1% ahead.

Simulator numbers are the community's model of the beta (ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e with this project's patches), not in-game measurements; the talents are the simulator's answer for this gear and rotation.
Pre-BiS gear: 19/32/0 at 781.7 DPS in a full raid (other talents: _reference/dps-rankings.md).
Alone on the training dummy (only your own buffs) the search's best is 20/31/0 at 416.9 DPS.
open_questions: A machine-searched Enhancement build: check it against the community's Enhancement builds at launch.
